## FSM Path-Based Representations Test Suite for U30_27

**States:**

* `Initial`
* `PatientRequestCreated`
* `AppointmentCreated`
* `DiagnosisProvided`
* `PrescriptionCreated`
* `LabRequestSuggested`
* `PrescriptionDelivered`

**Transitions:**

* `Initial` -> `PatientRequestCreated` (Patient submits consultation request)
* `PatientRequestCreated` -> `AppointmentCreated` (Appointment request is created)
* `PatientRequestCreated` -> `DiagnosisProvided` (Offline consultation request is submitted)
* `AppointmentCreated` -> `DiagnosisProvided` (Doctor provides diagnosis)
* `DiagnosisProvided` -> `PrescriptionCreated` (Doctor prescribes medicines)
* `DiagnosisProvided` -> `LabRequestSuggested` (Doctor suggests lab tests)
* `PrescriptionCreated` -> `PrescriptionDelivered` (Chemist delivers medicines)

**Initial State:** `Initial`

**Events/Guards:**

* `PatientSubmitsRequest` (patient submits consultation request)
* `DoctorProvidesDiagnosis` (doctor provides diagnosis)
* `ChemistDeliversMedicines` (chemist delivers medicines)

**Test Cases:**

| ID | Title | Req IDs | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Create Appointment Request | [Req-6, Req-6/1, Req-6/2] | Positive | Patient is registered | Symptoms, reports, appointment mode | Submit consultation request | Appointment request is created in Patient Appointment File |
| TC-002 | Create Offline Consultation Request | [Req-6, Req-6/1] | Positive | Patient is registered | Symptoms, reports, offline mode | Submit consultation request | Consultation request is created in Patient Consultation File |
| TC-003 | Invalid Appointment Mode | [Req-6/1] | Negative | Patient is registered | Symptoms, reports, invalid mode | Submit consultation request | Error message is displayed |
| TC-004 | Create Appointment Request for Next Day | [Req-6/2] | Positive | Patient is registered | Symptoms, reports, appointment mode, next day date | Submit consultation request | Appointment request is created in Patient Appointment File |
| TC-005 | Create Consultation Request with Missing Symptoms | [Req-6/1] | Negative | Patient is registered | Missing symptoms, reports, mode | Submit consultation request | Error message is displayed |
| TC-006 | Create Consultation Request with Missing Reports | [Req-6/1] | Negative | Patient is registered | Symptoms, missing reports, mode | Submit consultation request | Error message is displayed |
| TC-007 | Create Consultation Request with Missing Mode | [Req-6/1] | Negative | Patient is registered | Symptoms, reports, missing mode | Submit consultation request | Error message is displayed |
| TC-008 | Doctor Provides Diagnosis | [Req-7, Req-8] | Positive | Consultation request is created | Patient symptoms, reports | Provide diagnosis | Diagnosis is provided in Patient Consultation File |
| TC-009 | Doctor Prescribes Medicines | [Req-7, Req-8] | Positive | Diagnosis is provided | Patient diagnosis | Create prescription | Prescription is created in Patient Consultation File |
| TC-010 | Doctor Suggests Lab Tests | [Req-7, Req-8] | Positive | Diagnosis is provided | Patient diagnosis | Suggest lab tests | Lab tests are suggested in Patient Consultation File |
| TC-011 | Chemist Delivers Medicines | [Req-9] | Positive | Prescription is created | Patient prescription | Deliver medicines | Medicines are delivered to patient |
